# Made-in-China.com

> Global B2B marketplace connecting international buyers with Chinese manufacturers, suppliers, and wholesale products across industrial machinery, electronics, and automation solutions.

Made-in-China.com serves as a comprehensive platform for sourcing products from verified Chinese manufacturers, featuring supplier profiles, product catalogs, and trade show information like SMART EXPO. The platform specializes in industrial equipment, power electronics, and manufacturing machinery with quality certifications like ISO 9001.

- B2B Marketplace

- SMART EXPO

## Platform Overview

- [Made-in-China.com - Manufacturers, Suppliers & Products in China](https://m.made-in-china.com/): Main B2B marketplace homepage connecting international buyers with Chinese manufacturers and suppliers across all product categories

## Supplier Profiles - Power Electronics & Automation

- [Sikes Electric Co., Ltd - Passive Harmonic Filter & Power Electronics Supplier](https://m.made-in-china.com/company-sikes-elecric/): Manufacturer profile for harmonic filters, sinewave filters, braking units for inverters, line reactors, AC chokes, and power resistors for industrial automation
